text: Sorry I'm a childminder and one of my mindees, 4 yr old boy, has come up in a red blotchy rash on his tummy and back in the last hour. I panicked and did the glass thing and it does go pale and fade when I press. His colour's normal, lips are pink, he looks like himself. Parents aren't picking up till late and I'm shaking a bit honestly, I don't want to get this wrong. Is there anything else I should be checking for??
